title: LAN Security Hard Gate for Relay Exposure
purpose: Refuse unsafe non-loopback startup unless relay authentication, host allowlists, and intentional LAN exposure are configured. Make LAN mode fail-closed.
problem: Relay auth is only enabled when RELAY_TOKEN is set. Binding to 0.0.0.0 without auth is dangerous. Pilot docs use wrong env var LOCAL_AI_BIND and some curls omit Authorization.

included: Refuse startup when host is not loopback unless RELAY_TOKEN, explicit LAN mode, and required allowlists are configured
Require explicit LAN mode flag/config rather than silently accepting arbitrary 0.0.0.0
Require relay host and capability allowlists in LAN mode
Startup security summary: binding, auth state, trusted hosts, exposed capabilities
Tests proving unauthenticated relay calls fail in LAN mode
Authenticated curl/examples in every Relay Node document that shows network calls
Align pilot docs with LOCAL_AI_HOST and real auth headers
Harden central execution gate behavior to match documented policy where code already claims enforcement
excluded: Zero-touch pairing or per-node credential rotation

acceptanceCriteria.description: Server refuses to start on non-loopback host without RELAY_TOKEN + explicit LAN mode + required allowlists
Loopback default still starts without RELAY_TOKEN (dev ergonomics preserved)
Tests prove unauthenticated relay mutation/list calls fail when LAN mode or RELAY_TOKEN enforcement is active
Startup prints security summary covering bind, auth, trusted hosts, exposed capabilities
Relay pilot and API examples that hit protected endpoints include Authorization headers
Pilot docs use LOCAL_AI_HOST consistently with server.js
